prompt: Use the bundled bounded excerpt for a source whose longer semantic body is inaccessible. Another saved case says its audio was not listened to. Explain what can be transferred and what remains unknown without treating missing body as deleted/absent.
raw_outputs:

Its later content and whole-work structure remain **unknown**; the inaccessible material should not be treated as deleted or as evidence that nothing followed.

The visual hold and micro-changes may inform a new held-shot design if useful. Whether the source contains speech, music, silence, or other sound remains **unknown**. Do not infer an audio cue—or its absence—from the visual observation.
